package events_db

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// QueryEvents runs under the HTTP request's (cancellable) context. go-sqlite3
// < 1.14.51 spawned a goroutine and a channel for every row in that case.
func TestVerifyQueryEventsCancellationOverhead(t *testing.T) {
	const rows = 500
	ctx := context.Background()
	store, err := NewSqlite(ctx, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "events.db"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := store.CreateDebugSession(ctx, "verify"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < rows; i++ {
		if err := store.WriteEvent(ctx, "verify", "feature", json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"i":%d}`, i))); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	measure := func(c context.Context) float64 {
		return testing.AllocsPerRun(5, func() {
			page, err := store.QueryEvents(c, "verify", nil, rows, 0)
			if err != nil || len(page.Events) != rows {
				t.Fatalf("QueryEvents: %v (%d events)", err, len(page.Events))
			}
		})
	}
	cctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	plain := measure(ctx)
	cancellable := measure(cctx)
	perRow := (cancellable - plain) / rows
	fmt.Printf("allocs: background=%.0f cancellable=%.0f extra/row=%.2f\n", plain, cancellable, perRow)
	if perRow > 0.5 {
		t.Fatalf("cancellable context costs %.2f extra allocations per row", perRow)
	}
}
